src.title: Make and crack secret codes — Cipher Forge | MigaBuilder
src.description: Write secret messages in Caesar shift, Atbash, Vigenère, Morse, Pigpen, number code and more. Decode them automatically, read a coded note from a photo, crack an unknown shift, and hide a message inside a photo.
faq: Which secret codes can it make?

Caesar shift (any number), ROT13, Atbash (backwards alphabet), Vigenère (keyword), number code (A=1), Morse code, Pigpen symbols, phone keypad, binary, backwards writing and the rail fence zig-zag. Each one comes with instructions for decoding it by hand.
Can it decode a message when I don't know the code?
Yes. Press “Crack it” and it tries every shift and every simple code, then shows the answers that read most like real words first. Keyword codes like Vigenère need the keyword.
How does hiding a message in a photo work?

The message is stored in tiny colour changes that you cannot see. The photo looks the same, but Cipher Forge can read the message back. Add a password to lock it. Send the PNG as a file: apps that compress photos destroy the hidden message.
Are my messages uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser. Reading text from a photo downloads a recognition model once, but your photo stays on your device.

Cada uno incluye instrucciones para descifrarlo a mano.
faq.Can it decode a message when I don't kno: ¿Puede descifrar un mensaje si no sé el código?

faq.How does hiding a message in a photo wor: ¿Cómo funciona esconder un mensaje en una foto?
faq.The message is stored in tiny colour cha: El mensaje se guarda en cambios de color diminutos que no se ven. La foto se ve igual, pero Cipher Forge puede leer el mensaje. Añade una contraseña para bloquearlo. Envía el PNG como archivo: las apps que comprimen fotos destruyen el mensaje oculto.

src.description: Learn the game of Go (Baduk, Weiqi) with interactive lessons, then play against the computer at six levels on 9×9, 13×13 or 19×19. Press a button for advice on your next move or feedback on the move you just made. Free, no signup, runs on your device.
faq: How do I learn to play Go?

Start with the lessons: liberties, capturing, atari, connecting, eyes, ko and counting. Each lesson has small puzzles on a real board. Then play the capture game and small 9×9 games against the easiest computer level, and press Advice or Feedback whenever you are unsure.
Can I get hints while I play Go?

Yes. Press Advice for my next move to see the computer's best idea and why, or Feedback on my last move to see how good your move was and what would have been better. You can also ask the coach to warn you before a big mistake.
Which board size should a beginner use?
Start on 9×9: games take about ten minutes and every principle of the big board already appears. Move to 13×13 and then 19×19 when 9×9 feels comfortable.
Is Go Forge free?
Yes. It is free with no account, and the computer opponent runs on your own device, so it also works offline.

faq: What is Markdown?

Markdown is a simple way to format text with ordinary characters: # for a heading, **bold**, *italic*, - for a list and [text](link) for a link. It is used on GitHub, in README files, notes apps, chat apps and many websites.
Can I turn a Word document or web page into Markdown?
Yes. Open a .docx file, or copy text from Word, Google Docs or a web page and paste it into the editor. Headings, lists, links, bold text and tables become Markdown.
Is my text saved?
Your text is saved automatically in this browser only, so it is still there when you come back. It is never uploaded to MigaBuilder.
Is Markdown Forge free?
Yes. It is free to use, with no account, no watermark and no paywall.

src.title: Mind maps, flowcharts and a whiteboard — Mind Map | MigaBuilder
src.description: Free mind map maker, flowchart tool and online whiteboard: add ideas with one key, draw arrows and sticky notes, sketch freehand, turn an indented list or a topic (with AI) into a map, and download PNG, SVG or an outline. No signup — your map stays in your browser.
faq: Can I make a flowchart too?
Yes. Use the box, decision and start/end shapes and the arrow tool, or start from the flowchart template. Click an arrow twice to write Yes or No on it.
Can I turn a list into a mind map?
Yes. Paste an indented list or bullet points under “Turn a list into a map”, and each indent becomes a branch. You can also download any map as an outline.
Is Mind Map free?
Yes. It is free to use, with no account, no watermark and no paywall.
Are my maps uploaded?
No. Your map is saved only in this browser, and you can download it as a file. Only the optional “Make a map with AI” button sends your topic to an AI service.

faq.Can I make a flowchart too?: ¿También puedo hacer un diagrama de flujo?

faq.Can I turn a list into a mind map?: ¿Puedo convertir una lista en un mapa mental?
faq.Yes. Paste an indented list or bullet po: Sí. Pega una lista con sangría o viñetas en «Convierte una lista en un mapa» y cada sangría será una rama. También puedes descargar cualquier mapa como esquema.
faq.Yes. It is free to use, with no account,: Sí. Es gratis, sin cuenta, sin marca de agua y sin muro de pago.
faq.No. Your map is saved only in this brows: No. Tu mapa se guarda solo en este navegador y puedes descargarlo como archivo. Solo el botón opcional «Crear un mapa con IA» envía tu tema a un servicio de IA.

faq: What is the difference between white, pink and brown noise?

White noise has the same energy at every frequency and sounds like a bright hiss. Pink noise has less energy in the high notes, so it sounds softer, like steady rain. Brown noise has even less, so it sounds like a deep rumble, like a waterfall or strong wind.
Which noise is best for sleep?

Most people find pink or brown noise, or rain, the most pleasant for sleep because they are less hissy than white noise. All of them help mainly by masking sudden sounds that wake you. Keep the volume low and use the sleep timer.
Can I mix noise with rain and other sounds?
Yes. Switch on any number of noises and nature sounds, set each one's volume, save the mix, share it as a link or download it as a WAV file.
Is Noise Forge free?
Yes. It is free, with no account. All sounds are made on your device, so nothing is streamed or uploaded.

src.title: Physics Map — planets, the history of the universe, black holes and theories | MigaBuilder
src.description: Explore physics visually: an animated Solar System with every planet’s real data, the history of the universe from the Big Bang to the far future, black holes from Gaia BH1 to M87*, and a map of physics theories from Newton to string theory. Calculate your weight on other planets, light travel times, E = mc², time dilation and black-hole sizes, then play physics quizzes. Free, no signup.
faq: How much would I weigh on Mars?
About 38% of your Earth weight: a person who weighs 60 kg on Earth would read about 23 kg on a scale on Mars.
How big is a black hole?
Its event horizon grows with its mass: about 3 km across for every Sun of mass it holds (radius 2.95 km per solar mass).
How old is the universe?
About 13.8 billion years, from measurements of the cosmic microwave background.
Is the data accurate?
Planet data follows NASA’s planetary fact sheets, rounded. Speculative ideas such as string theory and the multiverse are marked as untested.

src.title: Free AI image generator from text — no sign up — Picture Forge | MigaBuilder
src.description: Free AI image generator: describe a picture and Google Gemini (Nano Banana) makes it. Pick a style and shape, edit your own photos, change the result with plain words, then download PNG, JPG or WebP. No sign up.
faq: Which formats can I download?
PNG, JPG or WebP. You can also keep editing the picture in Image Studio.
Is Picture Forge free?

Yes. It is free to use, with no account, no watermark and no paywall. The page itself is free, but Google charges for every AI picture, so pictures need your own Gemini key with billing turned on (about 7 US cents each). Google gives no free picture credit.
Are my files uploaded?

Only the text you give the AI leaves your device: it is sent to Google’s Gemini model through MigaBuilder’s free AI service, or through your own Gemini key if you add one. Editing, previews and downloads all happen in your browser.
